name: @visuelconcept-winccoa/wui-auth-badge
description: Badge login for the WebUI shell — a login provider's login extension: an RFID reader in keyboard emulation, badge → user through the RFID_UID user setting, the login page locked after three unknown badges, an audit line per event; "Mon badge" (/auth-badge) lets a user associate their badge when self-service is on; "Badges" (/auth-badge/admin), by Application Security role, turns the badge login on or off, opens or closes self-service and enrols any user's badge; "Switch user" in the menu.

notes: reader frame prefix: WUI_BADGE_PREFIX in the webserver's environment, until one is saved on Badges
audit lines go to an _AuditTrail DP, when it exists: auditDp in the [wui-auth] section of config/config (auditDp = "AuditTrail_MSP"), else WUI_AUTH_AUDIT_DP, else AuditTrail_Auth
settings (badge login enabled, self-service enrolment, the reader's frame: prefix, burst, minimum length, end key) in the DP WuiAuthBadge_Config.settings, its type and DP created at the first change
